description: ON THE FIRST BUSINESS DAY OF A MONTH, AFTER THE DAILY BATCH,
PRINTS A STATEMENT FOR EVERY ACCOUNT FOR THE MONTH THAT
CLOSED: THE OPENING BALANCE, EVERY POSTING OF THE MONTH, THE
INTEREST AND FEES POSTED FOR IT AFTER IT CLOSED, AND THE
CLOSING BALANCE. A CLOSED ACCOUNT WITH NOTHING TO SHOW GETS
THE MONTH THAT CLOSED IS THE DUE MONTH OF THE DAY'S ACCRUALS.
THE POSTINGS ARE READ FROM EVERY AUDIT TRAIL, NEWEST FIRST,
PICKED BY DATE AND SORTED BY ACCOUNT, DATE AND THE ORDER THEY
WERE READ IN, WHICH WITHIN A DAY IS THE ORDER THEY POSTED IN.
THEY ARE MATCHED AGAINST THE MASTER THE MONTH CLOSED WITH.
RETURN CODES: 0 PRINTED OR NO MONTH CLOSED,
16 POSTINGS FOR NO ACCOUNT, SORT FAILED OR I/O.
2004-03-15 TL  CR-0390 THE CODE TABLE FROM CODETAB, SHARED

identification.text: FIRST BANK OF PANGAEA, DATA CENTER.

records.name: ACCRUAL-RECORD
records.description: ACCRREC: INTEREST ACCRUAL RECORD, 40 BYTES ONE PER ACCOUNT, IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER LIKE THE MASTER. INTEREST IS ACCRUED FOR EVERY CALENDAR DAY BEFORE THE THROUGH DATE, TO SIX DECIMALS, AND IS NEGATIVE FOR AN OVERDRAWN BALANCE. WHEN A MONTH CLOSES, ITS INTEREST BECOMES DUE, ROUNDED TO THE CENT; THE FRACTION STAYS ACCRUED. THE DUE MONTH IS ZERO ON THE DAYS NO MONTH CLOSES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2001-09-03 TL  CR-0298 ORIGINAL VERSION.

records.name: ACCT-MASTER-RECORD
records.description: ACCTMAST: ACCOUNT MASTER RECORD, 100 BYTES IN ACCOUNT NUMBER ORDER. THE BALANCE MAY GO BELOW ZERO DOWN TO THE OVERDRAFT LIMIT, AND BELOW THAT ONLY BY FEES. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 1987-03-12 JA  ORIGINAL VERSION. 1994-11-14 PK  CR-0201 OVERDRAFT LIMIT, FROM THE FILLER. 1999-01-11 SL  Y2K: 8-DIGIT DATES.

records.name: AUDIT-RECORD
records.description: AUDITREC: AUDIT TRAIL RECORD, 100 BYTES, ONE PER POSTING THE AMOUNT IS SIGNED: CREDITS POSITIVE, DEBITS NEGATIVE.

records.name: WS-CLOSED-MONTH
records.description: THE MONTH THAT CLOSED AND THE ONE AFTER IT, WHOSE FIRST BUSINESS DAY POSTED THE CLOSED MONTH'S INTEREST AND FEES.

records.name: WS-POSTING-KEY
records.description: THE KEY OF THE POSTING IN HAND: HIGH-VALUES AFTER THE LAST.

records.name: ST-CODE-VALUES
records.description: CODETAB: TRANSACTION CODE TABLE FOR EACH TRANSACTION CODE, WHAT A STATEMENT CALLS IT AND THE GENERAL LEDGER ACCOUNT ITS POSTINGS MEET ON THE OTHER SIDE OF CUSTOMER DEPOSITS. COPIED WITH THE PROGRAM'S OWN PREFIX FOR THE :P: TAGS: COPY CODETAB REPLACING ==:P:== BY ==ST==. MODIFICATION HISTORY DATE       BY  CHANGE 2004-03-15 TL  CR-0390 ORIGINAL VERSION, FROM STMTPRT, FOR THE GENERAL LEDGER SUMMARY.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.description: FIND THE MONTH THAT CLOSED, IF ONE DID, AND PRINT ITS STATEMENTS FROM THE SORTED POSTINGS.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.description: OPEN THE FILES AND TAKE THE CLOSED MONTH FROM THE ACCRUALS.

paragraphs.name: 2000-SELECT-POSTINGS
paragraphs.description: RELEASE THE POSTINGS OF THE CLOSED MONTH, AND THE INTEREST AND FEES POSTED FOR IT ON THE FIRST BUSINESS DAY OF THE NEXT.

paragraphs.name: 2100-RELEASE-POSTING
paragraphs.description: RELEASE ONE POSTING TO THE SORT.

paragraphs.name: 3000-PRINT-STATEMENTS
paragraphs.description: PRINT A STATEMENT FOR EACH ACCOUNT OF THE MASTER, WITH ITS SORTED POSTINGS. EVERY POSTING MUST BELONG TO AN ACCOUNT.

paragraphs.name: 3200-READ-MASTER
paragraphs.description: READ THE NEXT ACCOUNT OF THE MASTER.

paragraphs.name: 3300-PRINT-STATEMENT
paragraphs.description: PRINT ONE ACCOUNT'S STATEMENT, UNLESS IT IS CLOSED AND HAS NOTHING TO SHOW.

paragraphs.name: 3400-PRINT-HEADING
paragraphs.description: PRINT THE STATEMENT'S HEADING AND OPENING BALANCE.

paragraphs.name: 3500-PRINT-POSTING
paragraphs.description: PRINT ONE POSTING, DESCRIBED BY ITS TRANSACTION CODE.

paragraphs.name: 3600-PRINT-CLOSING
paragraphs.description: PRINT THE CLOSING BALANCE AND THE MONTH'S CREDITS AND DEBITS.

paragraphs.name: 8000-WRITE-REPORT
paragraphs.description: WRITE THE STATEMENT RUN'S REPORT. EVERY POSTING SELECTED MUST HAVE BEEN PRINTED.

paragraphs.name: 9900-ABORT
paragraphs.description: STOP THE RUN WITH RETURN CODE 16, SAYING WHY.
